note: Village of Dorchester's 43-acre park off Business County Road A and Park Street. A row of open-field pull-throughs east of the park road and wooded back-in loops beside a stocked fishing pond; primitive tent sites, two playgrounds, tennis, basketball and volleyball courts, a ball field, disc golf and a walking path. --Claude
summary: Village page (moved to dorchesterwi.gov) confirms 40 numbered sites: 9/11/13-26 W/E $22, 1-8/10/12 $25 (some with sewer), 27-40 full-hookup 50-amp pull-throughs $25; tents $12; showers + flush toilets; open May 1-Oct 15; FCFS (reservations only for large groups). Not waterfront kept. Website moved.
flags: WEBSITE: https://dorchesterwi.com/dorchester-park-camping-shelters/ -> https://dorchesterwi.gov/dorchester-park-camping-shelters/ (the .com now redirects to the .gov home page; the village site moved in January 2026).
Phone 715-654-5098 (camping contact) confirmed on the village page and Google Maps.
DUMP: stored dump true is not mentioned on the village page; left as is.

Waterfront: not waterfront kept. The stocked pond (~3 ha, the village calls it a pond) lies west of the wooded loops; the nearest loop pads (~44.9990,-90.3285) are ~35-75 m from it behind trees and the park road. A pond across a block is not waterfront.
Long-stay: weekly and monthly rates are posted, but imagery shows only a handful of units and no set-up seasonal look; Google Maps 4.6 from 124 reviews. No seasonal concern.
Pin 44.9998,-90.3263 kept (~70 m north of the camping loops' centre at ~44.9992,-90.3263).
